map.默认参数（草酸钙结石，pH 6.0、饮水 1500 mL、蛋白 1.2 g/kg: Default parameters (calcium oxalate stone, pH 6.0, water 1500 mL, protein 1.2 g/kg, sodium 3000 mg, oxalate 150 mg): pH 0 + water 1 + protein 0 + sodium 1 + oxalate 0 = 2 points, judged low risk; the tool will flag "insufficient water intake (recommended >2000mL/day)" and "high sodium intake increases urinary calcium excretion". Compare the high-risk scenario (uric acid stone, pH 5.2, water 800 mL, protein 1.8 g/kg, sodium 4500 mg, oxalate 300 mg): 5 + 5 + 3 + 3 + 3 = 19 points, judged very high risk, with advice to alkalinise the urine to pH 6.5-7.0, restrict sodium to <2300 mg/day and reduce protein to 0.8-1.0 g/kg/day.
map.同为尿结石，为什么 pH 的评分方向随结石类型变化？: All are urinary stones, so why does the scoring direction of pH change with stone type?
map.不同结晶的溶解度对 pH 的依赖相反：尿酸在酸性尿中溶解度最低（pH 5.0 时: The dependence of crystal solubility on pH is opposite in different crystals: uric acid has its lowest solubility in acidic urine (almost insoluble at pH 5.0, solubility about 10 times higher at pH 6.5), hence the points for acidic urine; calcium phosphate and infection (magnesium ammonium phosphate) stones are the opposite, since alkaline urine promotes precipitation, hence points when pH>7.0; calcium oxalate stones are relatively insensitive to pH, and the main penalty points are water intake, sodium and oxalate.
map.评分低是否代表不会长结石？: Does a low score mean stones will not form?
map.不代表。本工具只覆盖饮食与尿液 pH 这几个可控因素，未纳入尿钙/尿枸橼酸/尿酸: No. This tool covers only a few controllable factors, namely diet and urine pH, and does not include urinary calcium/citrate/urate excretion, measured urine volume, anatomical abnormalities, family history, parathyroid function and other clinical indicators. The score serves trend observation for dietary self-management and cannot replace 24-hour urine stone risk analysis and imaging follow-up.
map.尿酸结石在酸性尿(pH<5.5)中易形成，碱化至pH 6.5-7.0可预防: Uric acid stones form easily in acidic urine (pH<5.5); alkalinising to pH 6.5-7.0 prevents them
map.草酸钙结石最常见，与尿钙、草酸浓度和饮水量密切相关: Calcium oxalate stones are the most common and are closely linked to urinary calcium, oxalate concentration and water intake
map.每日饮水量应>2000mL，保持尿量>2L是最有效预防方法: Daily water intake should be >2000mL; keeping urine output >2L is the most effective prevention
